items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed an EEO complaint alleging that the Agency discriminated against her on the basis of disability (physical- neck and shoulder) when: 1.
Beginning on or about [MASK] and ongoing, she was continually harassed (questioned) about her work restrictions and not provided work assistance; 2.
Beginning on or about [MASK], and continuing, she was required to do the walking portion of her route; 3.
On [MASK], she was yelled at and embarrassed in front of her coworkers; 4.
On [MASK], she was required to submit a new CA-17 and not paid for the time she missed from work to get the CA-17 completed; 5.
